[NPC] Susan: Hey, are you here to volunteer for the Safety Squad?
[NPC] Susan: Good heavens, that's great news!

prerequisites.instruction: Click &a[Sounds good with me!]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Susan: Processing your registration...
Warped to Security Hall!
[NPC] Brigette: Hey, recruit!
[NPC] Brigette: Yes, you!

prerequisites.instruction: Click &a[What is a safety-related incident anyway?]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: I'm glad you asked.

prerequisites.instruction: Click &a[What's the point of Account Safety?]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: Imagine logging in to SkyBlock and finding that all your belongings have disappeared.

prerequisites.instruction: Click &9[I don't want to lose my account!]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: And that's why you should pay close attention to today's briefing.

prerequisites.instruction: Click &c[That doesn't sound good.]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: Of course it doesn't.
[NPC] Brigette: If someone approaches you, they very likely want something from you.

prerequisites.instruction: Click &c[I'm not stupid enough to open a random link!]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: I'm sure you're not!

prerequisites.instruction: Click &c[C'mon, I'm sure it's not &othaaat&r&c complicated.]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: A way hackers can gain your trust is by messaging you from an account they've already hacked.

prerequisites.instruction: Click &d[Brigette, you're quite scary.]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: Scary I am indeed.
[NPC] Brigette: The dangers of clicking unverified links is not limited to within SkyBlock.

prerequisites.instruction: Click &b[Links for SkyBlock outside SkyBlock? Like what?]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: For example, you may be trying to download a mod for SkyBlock.

prerequisites.instruction: Click &b[I will be careful when clicking on links, I promise!]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: That's the spirit!
[NPC] Brigette: Sorry
[NPC] Jimmy: Hi, the name's Jimmy.
[NPC] Jimmy: This place looks awesome. I'm all about security.

prerequisites.instruction: Click &a[Security is indeed very important.]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Jimmy: I got these really cool gauntlets. It lets me fight against baddies.
Jimmy glances at the player.
[NPC] Jimmy: Great, we're now besties!

prerequisites.instruction: Click &a[I volunteered to be part of the Safety Squad.]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Jimmy: That's cool. I got here because I got into a scuffle with the Security Sloth.
[NPC] Brigette: STOP RIGHT THERE!
[NPC] Brigette: Jimmy is currently wanted for twelve counts of scamming and five more counts of assault.
[NPC] Brigette: Lucky for you, he couldn't pull off his scam within the Security Hall.

prerequisites.instruction: Click &a[How does this scam work?]&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: Jimmy would show you his "very cool gauntlets" in the trading menu.
[NPC] Brigette: There are many other forms of these scams

prerequisites.instruction:
Click any of the following in chat:
&e@ &aIt can lead you to lose a lot of items and money.&r
&e@ &aIt can lead you to lose access to your Minecraft account.&r
&e@ &aIt can lead you to lose your Hypixel SkyBlock profile.&r
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: Correct! In fact, all of the listed statements are true - losing your account can mean lost items, money, profiles, or even your whole Microsoft account.

prerequisites.instruction: Click &e@ &aLeave the party and report the player.&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: YOU GOT IT! You can report the player with the /report command, followed by the player's username.

prerequisites.instruction: Click &e@ &aLook for signs of your friend getting hacked, and don't click on that website any further.&r in chat
prerequisites.criteria: [NPC] Brigette: That's right! You can try to reach out to your friend through other methods of contact to verify if it's really them. Even so, you should try and verify that the link is from a reputable website - google the domain name to make sure you're landing at the right website.
